name: Viscous Poison
body:
You can make your sticky poison even stickier.

Prerequisite(s): Sticky poison alchemist discovery, assassin level 1st.

Benefit(s): You can use your poison expertise to increase the duration of sticky poison. When the viscous poison is applied to a weapon, the weapon remains poisoned for an additional number of rounds equal to half your assassin level (minimum 1).

Normal: The sticky poison alchemist discovery allows the weapon to remain poisoned for a number of rounds equal to your Intelligence modifier.
